agency: Board of Education District No. 170, Chicago Heights, Illinois
summary: The Board of Education District 170 (the entity that actually responded, rather than Luedner) determined that the playfield is a grassed area not used for formal recreation, that no plans exist to convert it to formal recreation, and that its use is not significant to the community's recreational needs; the Illinois DOT concurred with all three findings.
text:
5.) Pursuant to your request, I have reviewed the status of the playfield located west of Sunnyside and east of Franklin Avenues. The following has been determined:

5(a) The playfield is a grassed area and not used for formal recreation.

5(b) No plans for cqnverting the playfield to a formal recreation area are being presently made or in the foreseeable future.

5(c) The use of the playfield is not significant to the recreational needs of the community.
opening_anchor: 5.) Pursuant to your request, I have reviewed the status of the playfield located west of Sunnyside and east of Franklin Avenues.
closing_anchor: 5(c) The use of the playfield is not significant to the recreational needs of the community.
